title: Gangqinpu: A Multi-Genre, Multi-Task Piano Dataset with Aligned Audio, MIDI, and Musical Scores
abstract: arXiv:2610.34694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aligned audio, performance MIDI, and musical scores provide valuable supervision for music analysis and performance modeling, yet datasets that jointly align all three modalities remain scarce and limited in scale and genre diversity. We introduce Gangqinpu, a multi-genre piano dataset containing 18,786 score-performance pairs and 1,007.1 hours of source audio, with automatic note-level alignments and derived beat/downbeat annotations. It spans diverse genres, including pop, classical, jazz, folk/traditional, rock, and blues. Our automated pipeline transcribes piano audio, aligns the resulting MIDI with musical scores, assigns genre labels, and filters out non-expressive performances with a score-informed binary classifier. We further construct joint splits with ASAP using conservative score-similarity grouping to reduce data leakage. translated_title: Gangqinpu（钢琴谱）：一个包含对齐音频、MIDI与乐谱的多流派、多任务钢琴数据集
translated_abstract: 对齐的音频、演奏MIDI和乐谱为音乐分析与演奏建模提供了宝贵的监督信号，然而能够同时对齐这三种模态的数据集仍然稀缺，且在规模和流派多样性上较为有限。我们提出了Gangqinpu，一个多流派钢琴数据集，包含18,786对乐谱-演奏配对和1,007.1小时的源音频，并提供自动音符级对齐以及由此派生的节拍/强拍标注。该数据集涵盖多种流派，包括流行、古典、爵士、民谣/传统、摇滚和布鲁斯。我们的自动化流程对钢琴音频进行转录，将所得MIDI与乐谱对齐，分配流派标签，并通过乐谱感知的二分类器过滤掉缺乏表现力的演奏。我们进一步使用保守的乐谱相似性分组，构建了与ASAP数据集的联合划分，以减少数据泄漏。我们在演奏MIDI到乐谱的转录、表现性演奏渲染等任务上对Gangqinpu进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了Gangqinpu，一个包含18,786对乐谱-演奏配对、超过1000小时音频、覆盖多种流派并实现音频-MIDI-乐谱自动对齐的多任务钢琴数据集。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Gangqinpu, a multi-genre, multi-task piano dataset with 18,786 score-performance pairs and over 1,000 hours of audio, featuring automatic alignment among audio, MIDI, and musical scores.
